description: This is a test module for the AutoRouter class in the litellm router strategy. It contains unit tests using pytest and mocks to verify initialization, pre-routing hook behavior, and interactions with external components like the SemanticRouter.

classes.name: TestAutoRouter
classes.description: Test class containing various unit tests for the AutoRouter class, including initialization and pre-routing hook behaviors.

methods.name: mock_router_instance()
methods.description: Creates a mock LiteLLM Router instance with an asynchronous completion method.

methods.name: mock_semantic_router()
methods.description: Creates a mock SemanticRouter instance with predefined routes.

methods.name: mock_route_choice()
methods.description: Creates a mock RouteChoice object with a name attribute.

methods.name: test_init(self, mock_semantic_router_class, mock_router_instance)
methods.description: Tests the initialization of the AutoRouter class with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: test_async_pre_routing_hook_with_route_choice( self, mock_encoder_class, mock_semantic_router_class, mock_router_instance, mock_route_choice )
methods.description: Verifies that async_pre_routing_hook returns the correct model when a route is found.

methods.name: test_async_pre_routing_hook_with_list_route_choice( self, mock_encoder_class, mock_semantic_router_class, mock_router_instance, mock_route_choice )
methods.description: Checks handling of a list of RouteChoice objects in async_pre_routing_hook.

methods.name: test_async_pre_routing_hook_no_messages(self, mock_router_instance)
methods.description: Ensures async_pre_routing_hook returns None when no messages are provided.

ctags.name: pytestmark
ctags.pattern: /^pytestmark = pytest.mark.skip(reason="Skipping auto router tests - beta feature")$/

fields.name: pytestmark = pytest.mark.skip(reason="Skipping auto router tests - beta feature")
